game.candidate.generate.deterministic.mu: The TEST-labelled deterministic game candidate generator emits one byte-bound 11-file static web-game packet, but its only admitted recipe is the single-player Four Roots grid game.
game.runtime.local-two-player-action/v1: Workshop game examples demonstrate same-device co-op, but no exact deterministic Fabric recipe emits a two-player action candidate.
game.coop.shared-outcome-and-revive/v1: The current generated candidate has one player and no shared objective, shared loss, downed-player, or revive contract.
game.input.two-keyboard-seats/v1: The current recipe merges arrows and WASD into one seat; it does not preserve two independently observable input seats.
game.runtime.offline-session-only/v1: Generated game candidates declare DISABLED network, SESSION_ONLY persistence, zero permissions, and browser-memory ownership.
game.preview.detached-sandbox/v1: The disposable candidate sandbox can materialize exact packet bytes into disjoint source/output/evidence roots and serve a sandboxed local preview without installation.
game.verify.deterministic-two-seat-simul: No generated two-seat engine exists to prove independent movement, attacks, dash, revive, wave completion, shared loss, replay determinism, or bounded state.
game.verify.live-two-seat-journey/v1: No browser-rendered Fabric-generated two-player action candidate has been observed and controlled through both seats.
authority.detached-zero/v1: The generator and sandbox refuse provider calls, candidate process execution, host environment inheritance, network, writes outside detached roots, install, integration, publish, promotion, and CANON change.
